title: Government sponsored study on alcohol doesn't stand up to scrutiny
summary: Nassim Taleb critiques a government-sponsored study on alcohol, questioning its scientific methodology and statistical validity. The article examines how official health research may fail to meet rigorous standards of evidence.
problem_solved: Exposes methodological flaws and lack of scientific rigor in government-sponsored alcohol research.
why_valuable: Highlights the importance of statistical scrutiny and skepticism toward official health studies that often influence public policy.
